\/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain in the epigastrium since 5 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBurning micturition since 5 days \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 days back which when he developed pain in the abdomen. \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain was insidious in onset gradually progressive, dragging type of pain, aggrevating during night.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain radiating to the back, and relieving on leaning forward \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBurning micturition since 5 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o vomiting\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o constipation \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eknown case of \u0026nbsp;diabetes since 1 week \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case of HTN, Seizures, TB\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY: not significant\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY: not significant \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EApetite: decreased\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel bladder: burning micturition\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: disturbed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of consumption of alcohol since 10 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDAILY ROUTINE\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient wakes up at 6 am in the morning and freshens up and goes for a walk and has a cup of tea later. He then goes for farming and has his lunch at around 2pm. He comes back home by 5pm in the evening and has his tea biscuits and finishes his dinner by 9 pm and goes to sleep.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe consumes alcohol on alternate days, of quantity 90ml (100rs). He has started drinking to overcome tiredness and fatigue at the end of the day, and continues to do so until 5 days back when he had this acute exacerbation of pain on alcohol consumption.
